newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Delifrance Asia IPO 5.5 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Delifrance Asia IPO 5.5 times subscribed.

text.p: The initial public offer (IPO) of Delifrance Asia Ltd was subscribed 5.5 times, a source close to the share issue said.
The source gave no other details.
Delifrance Asia Ltd had offered 45.16 million shares at a price of Singapore $0.78 each. The offer closed on Thursday.

There was no placement tranche in the share offering by Delifrance, a cafe and bakeries chain. However, the company had said up to 10 percent of the shares would be reserved for management, staff and business associates of the group.

Trading will begin on a when-issued basis on the Stock Exchange of Singapore's main board on October 21. Delifrance said the offer price represented an historical price-earnings ratio of 17.26 times. The offer was managed and underwritten by OCBC Bank. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
